free_text_notes.physician_note: 56-year-old woman with hypertension, dementia (mild), admitted 2/28 with left lower lobe pneumonia with small parapneumonic effusion. Leukocytosis resolved; tolerating diet.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. A chest X-ray taken on admission showed mild changes. A repeat X-ray on day 3 shows significant improvement and the radiologist has cleared the patient for discharge.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with son. 3/5 18:00: Team decision tonight: metformin held until follow-up (was 1000 mg twice daily). Son called asking about the plan and does not know about the change; has not been able to reach the physician. Patient's pharmacy cannot fill the new prescription yet. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead. Patient asked to move the PCP appointment; rebooked within 7 days of discharge.
